description: Use this when the user has seen a program preview and clearly said to save it. It saves that preview to the connected Phorme account as a private program and returns a link that opens it in Phorme. It needs a connected Phorme account with the training:write permission and a Phorme membership that already includes programs. If the account does not have that membership the tool says so and saves nothing. It never starts a purchase. Retrying with the same idempotency_key does not create a second copy.

confirmation.description: Set to true only after the user clearly confirmed this save in the conversation.

idempotency_key.description: A unique string for this save. Reuse the same value when retrying so no second copy is created.

preview_id.description: The preview_id of the preview being saved.

name: save_program_to_phorme

open_url.description: Link that opens the saved training in Phorme.

title: Save program to Phorme
